critical_findings.detail: 70 ATR SL hits in 7d. 60/70 (86%) have 2x+ slippage. 52/70 (74%) have 3x+ slippage. Stop set at 1.3% but actual losses 4-11%. Example: IMX stop=-1.3% actual=-11.07%, FIL stop=-1.3% actual=-9.83%.
critical_findings.root_cause: Low-liquidity coins gap through stops. Market orders on thin books = massive slippage. HL execution on altcoins is poor.
critical_findings.impact: This IS the #1 loss source. 70 trades, avg -0.11% per hit = massive drag. But widening stops wont help per CEO analysis.
critical_findings.recommendation: DO NOT widen stops. Instead: (1) Block LONG in BTC_BEAR_TREND (see CRIT-2), (2) Improve entry quality via chase filter + regime filters. The stop slippage is a symptom of bad entries, not tight stops.

critical_findings.detail: 42 trades when BTC regime=BEAR_TREND: 33.3%WR, -$2.34. pullback-entry- SHORT alone: 27T 33.3%WR -$1.62. When BTC trends bearish, even SHORT signals lose because altcoins are whipsawing.

critical_findings.impact: -$2.34/7d from this regime alone. Fixing this alone would turn 7d negative to positive.
critical_findings.recommendation: Add BTC_BEAR_TREND penalty for SHORT signals OR reduce SHORT confidence when BTC is in BEAR_TREND. Monitor 48h before implementing.
